title: Instant Answer Rendering, Sync Deduplication & Spoiler Guards
body:
- Removed the artificial 1-second minimum display delay on the client so fast local-KB and cached answers appear immediately, and pre-warmed template engines on backend startup.
- Fixed duplicate guest and user guesses appearing after login by claiming existing guest guess rows in `/sync` across all modes and deduplicating linked guest rows in Admin sessions.
- Expanded deterministic open-ended question detection across Countrydle and regional modes so non-yes/no questions are caught without deducting a turn.
- Added numeric leak filtering to fallback and border-count clarifications so threshold questions never reveal exact counts.
